findings: The contract pins LANG and LC_CTYPE to C.UTF-8, and pinned main.c initializes the locale before UTF-8 support.

The keymap binds Ctrl+F to forwchar and DEL (the public Backspace key encoding) to backdel. forwchar skips UTF-8 continuation bytes; backchar retreats across continuation bytes to the code point lead byte.

backdel deletes the logical character count returned by forwbytes; forwbytes advances by the full UTF-8 sequence length. Thus two Ctrl+F actions position after A and the wide CJK code point, and Backspace removes only the complete wide character.
The contract asserts A?B before editing, AB after deletion, saves, exits, and checks exact ASCII bytes AB newline.
safety: synthetic disposable UTF-8 file; explicit UTF-8 locale; secure mode -S; backups disabled with -n
